title: StrKey decodes a signed payload key whose padding bytes are not zero

target.versions_affected: 17.0.0 - 17.0.1 (executed: 17.0.0, 17.0.1; main 3d722d01 has the same code; earlier versions not run)

severity_basis: StrKey.decode_ed25519_signed_payload() checks how many padding bytes follow the payload but not their value, so two different P strings decode to the same signer and is_valid_ed25519_signed_payload() accepts both; code that compares signer keys as strings can treat one signer as two.

entries.expected: refuse a signed-payload strkey whose padding bytes are not zero (SEP-23)
entries.observed: Executed on 17.0.0 and 17.0.1: StrKey decoding returns the 1-byte payload with its three 0xff padding bytes instead of an error.

evidence.pre_fix: Conformance runner, L4, python@17.0.0 and python@17.0.1 (make verify-conformance and make verify-conformance-public), entry strkey/synthetic-gap-vectors.signed-payload-nonzero-padding: accepts_invalid.
evidence.expected_basis: SEP-23, encoding step 4: the payload is followed by 0 to 3 zero bytes so that its length is a multiple of four (https://github.com/stellar/stellar-protocol/blob/f2d364902615af726b3533021403c8b225aa6e5d/ecosystem/sep-0023.md).

reproduction.method: Re-run on 2026-11-18: the 2 listed report rows failed again in make verify-conformance-public and make verify-conformance, offline; the issue's script on 17.0.1 decodes the 0xff-padded key and is_valid returns True.

history.note: Recorded on 2026-11-18: filed by the maintainers of this kit on 2026-11-14 as https://github.com/StellarCN/py-stellar-base/issues/1258; this record restates the public issue.
Upstream: closed on 2026-11-14 by the merged pull request #1261; no release after 17.0.1 includes it yet.
